item.title: A popular ice cream brand sold at Walmart and Kroger files for bankruptcy after ‘trade dress’ lawsuit
item.description: Rebel Creamery has produced keto-friendly ice cream for almost a decade, but a judge recently ruled that its packaging is too similar to Van Leeuwen’s. A years-long lawsuit between two ice cream brands, Van Leeuwen Ice Cream and Rebel Creamery, has come to a possible end, with a federal judge ruling that Rebel infringed Van Leeuwen Ice Cream’s trade dress, and ordering that Rebel owes Van Leeuwen tens of millions of dollars....
